answer_1.quote: We primarily conducted experiments on single-turn dialogue tasks... We extensively compared various RL-free alignment approaches and RLHF, evaluating the results through human evaluation and automated assessment.

answer_2.quote: We assessed the performance of different models across three widely used benchmarks: Open LLM Leaderboard, AlpacaEval, and MT-Bench. Additionally, we evaluated safety on the Toxigen dataset using accuracy.

answer_3.quote: MT-Bench is a collection of challenging questions... this benchmark also employs GPT-4 as a judge to score the responses of models. AlpacaEval employs GPT-4 as an annotator to compare the generated content of models.

answer_4.quote: For the human evaluation, we assigned evaluators the task of comparing two randomly selected responses and providing judgments on their relative performance, categorizing them with three results: win, lose, or tie.
answer_4.guideline: Compare two randomly selected responses and label each as win, tie, or lose based on relative performance.
